📋 QA Regression & Smoke Test Report — September 2026

📱 Test Environment

Parameter Details
Device Samsung Galaxy A23 (SM-A235F)
OS Version Android 14 (One UI 6.1)
App Build Panorra Mobile v1.9.39 (Expo SDK 54 / React Native)
Tester Account testergothru@gmail.com (Real User Account)
Test Date 04 September 2026
Test Scope Category Selection Segment (Food, Nature, Stay), Active State Styling, Store Sync, Mapping to Backend Category IDs (5, 6, 7)

🔍 Code Review & Architectural Inspection

  • Component Under Test: src/pages/add-post/_components/publish/index.tsx (Lines 387–412) & src/pages/post-edit/description/index.tsx (Lines 278–290).
  • Segment State Synchronization: Managed via publishForm.category (PublishCategory = 'food' | 'nature' | 'stay') inside useAddPostStore and usePostEditStore.
  • Default Fallback: EMPTY_PUBLISH_FORM.category = 'nature', ensuring non-null category state on new post creation.
  • Backend ID Mapping: categoryIdFor(category) maps 'food' -> 5, 'nature' -> 6, 'stay' -> 7 deterministically during post creation, multipart uploads, and draft saves.
  • UI Responsiveness: Fast tap response on segment pills with dynamic active pill styling (bg-background shadow-sm) and FontAwesome Pro icons (faUtensils, faTree, faBed). Zero layout shifts or state inconsistencies detected.

🧪 Testing Methodologies Matrix

Test ID Method Test Type Scenario Description Expected Result Actual Result Status
TC-200-01 White Box Positive Select Food category segment publishForm.category updates to 'food', pill highlights active Segment highlights Food, icon & label active PASS
TC-200-02 White Box Positive Select Stay category segment publishForm.category updates to 'stay', pill highlights active Segment highlights Stay, icon & label active PASS
TC-200-03 White Box Positive Return selection to Nature publishForm.category updates to 'nature', pill highlights active Segment highlights Nature, icon & label active PASS
TC-200-04 Grey Box Positive Backend payload mapping validation Selected category correctly maps to backend integer (5, 6, 7) Store mapping categoryIdFor() outputs exact integer IDs PASS
TC-200-05 Black Box Negative Initial screen load without category interaction Default fallback category remains preselected (Nature) without null state Nature is selected by default upon entering Step 3 PASS
TC-200-06 Black Box Positive Post Edit mode category segment Category segment renders and toggles correctly during post editing Category updates seamlessly in edit mode PASS

📊 Confusion Matrix

Metric Calculation / Value Interpretation
True Positive (TP) 4 Category selections (Food, Nature, Stay) and backend ID mapping functioning correctly
True Negative (TN) 2 Default fallback active preventing null categories; invalid state unrepresentable
False Positive (FP) 0 No invalid transitions or UI glitches
False Negative (FN) 0 No blocked category selections or submission failures
Accuracy 100% (6 / 6 = 1.00) All test cases passed with zero functional or visual defects
Precision 100% (4 / (4 + 0) = 1.00) No false positive selections observed
Recall / Sensitivity 100% (4 / (4 + 0) = 1.00) All category selection pathways fully responsive
F1-Score 1.00 Perfect functional & visual consistency

🎥 Real Device Test Evidence

smoke_test_200.mp4

✅ Conclusion

  • Result: PASSED
  • All category options (Food, Nature, Stay) perform flawlessly across the UI, state store, and API payload mapping. No coding bugs or regressions encountered.
